prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Nitrogen (N) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: an ice-cream parlour of her element's kingdom — a marble counter, a brass freezing churn with frosted pipes and striped wallpaper
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: an ice-cream parlour look fitted to her body — a striped off-shoulder mini dress with a frilled half apron, thigh-high stockings and a paper cap, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a waist-high railing or sill.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on the railing — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds an ice-cream cone at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.
Scene note: she is an ice-cream parlour girl behind her counter

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — nitrogen: 78 percent of the air, the quiet bulk of every breath that helps scatter the sky blue; violet and pink aurora curtains where it glows high above the poles; so calm it barely reacts, its two atoms locked by an unbreakable triple bond; pulled from the air it becomes bread and gunpowder alike — fertilizer and explosives; poured as liquid nitrogen at minus 196 degrees it breathes thick white mist; the backbone of every protein and every strand of DNA — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
